prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency, as the top choice depends on your specific business goals, budget, and campaign requirements. basis.com
Top agencies excel in different areas:
Directive: Best for B2B and SaaS companies looking to tie connected TV directly to pipeline, revenue, and full-funnel performance metrics. Directive
Marketing Architects: Best for brands entering TV or expanding CTV for the first time that need end-to-end media planning, creative production, and response measurement. Directive
Tatari: Best for a platform-led, convergent approach that blends streaming and linear TV buying with real-time attribution and performance data. Business of Apps +1
Havas Edge: Best for scaling brands that are brand-new to streaming and want a strong focus on verified business outcomes rather than simple impression counts. Havas Edge
